reason: mainnet namespace preregistration MsgRun: registers the initial mainnet names (gnoswap, onbloc, moul, aeddi, aib) in r/sys/users via the genesis-only r/sys/users/init.RegisterUser wrapper. The controller gate is skipped at height 0, so no standing authority survives genesis; GovDAO can rename or delete any of these via r/sys/namereg/v1 proposals.
